about: Hand-curated venue research for Kol HaMusica, keyed by the codes its smarticket adapter gives the box office's place names. Every figure is {value, source}, or null when nobody could cite it; coordinates carry the basis they rest on and their source.

beit-haam-kfar-blum.name: בית העם כפר בלום

coordinates.basis: approximate: Kfar Blum's own coordinates, the kibbutz the venue is in

beit-haam-kfar-blum.notes: Kfar Blum's community hall. The box office says parking is in the Emek HaHula high school car park only.

klor-centre.name: מרכז קלור לאומנויות הבמה

coordinates.basis: approximate: Kfar Blum's own coordinates, the kibbutz the venue is in

klor-centre.notes: The Klor Centre for the Performing Arts in Kfar Blum; the box office names two of its halls, its hall (morning concerts) and its theatre hall (unreserved seating).

pastoral-hotel.name: מלון פסטורל, כפר בלום

coordinates.basis: approximate: Kfar Blum's own coordinates, the kibbutz the venue is in

pastoral-hotel.notes: The Pastoral hotel in Kfar Blum, the festival's home: its lawns and halls hold the Café Concert, the Work in Focus talks and the evening concerts. The box office names no hall.

jordan-bank.name: שפת הירדן

coordinates.basis: approximate: Kfar Blum's own coordinates, the kibbutz the venue is in

jordan-bank.notes: The family picnic plays outdoors on the bank of the Jordan; the box office gives its place only as "outside" and names no meeting point.

domus-galilaeae.name: דומוס גלילאה

coordinates.basis: the article's coordinates on English Wikipedia

domus-galilaeae.notes: Domus Galilaeae, the Neocatechumenal centre on the Mount of Beatitudes above the Sea of Galilee, about 35 km south of Kfar Blum.
